patch_description: Replace the line CZ topology with a brickwork ring (even pairs then odd pairs, forming a complete ring) plus cross connections (0↔4, 1↔5, 2↔6, 3↔7) for long-range entanglement. Replace the duplicate RZ layer with an RX layer, giving full SU(2) coverage per qubit (RY, RZ, RX). The brickwork pattern ensures every qubit is entangled with both neighbors in one block, and the cross connections let information from qubit 0 reach qubit 4 in a single block. This should dramatically improve information mixing while keeping the same parameter count of 146.
